text: {"label": "General Behavior Change Principles and Procedures", "definition": "Broad, mixed work on core behavior-change concepts and methods, including shaping, chaining, defining target behavior, motivating operations, behavior plans, functional analysis of problem behavior, and goal setting.", "distinct_from_neighbours": "It centers on practical concepts and procedures for producing behavior change, not evolutionary behavior theory, the scientific foundations of the field, or laboratory work on behavioral momentum and stability."}
